title: Scalable VIP Request Cadence & Triage Playbook for Customer Operations
creator: Morgan Lee
description:
Problem: As we scale Dedicated and Private deals, Customer Ops and AE teams need a repeatable, low-latency way to surface, triage, and commit to 'VIP' (top account) requests so we can meet revenue commitments without over-indexing engineering capacity. Current intake is ad-hoc: Slack threads, forwarded emails, and tickets that lack standardized impact signals leading to slow response times and unclear promises to customers.

Goal: Deliver a playbook and lightweight tooling that standardizes a VIP request cadence (intake -> Triage -> Commitment Window -> Handoff), plus a prioritization rubric that balances revenue urgency, SLA obligations, engineering effort, and long-term product fit. The outcome should reduce pledge ambiguity, cut time-to-response for VIP escalations by 50%, and provide telemetry for roadmap pull-through.

Scope:
- Define standardized intake form and minimal metadata required for VIP classification.
- Create a 4-step triage flow with SLAs and owner assignments (Customer Ops -> PM Triage -> Eng Triage -> Commitment Decision).
- Build a rubric and scorecard (revenue at risk, technical complexity, security/compliance constraints, strategic fit).
- Publish runbook + templates for AE/CS to use when making commitments.
- Provide minimal console/dashboard view (PM-owned) showing open VIP requests, SLA timers, and decision outcomes.

Out of scope for this ticket: automation of ticket creation in the issue tracker, deep integrations with billing; those are follow-ups.

Success metrics:
- Median first-response time to VIP intake <= 4 business hours (baseline ~8–12 hrs).
- 50% reduction in ambiguous customer commitments reported by CS in post-mortem audits.
- Traceability: >=90% of VIP commitments linked to a PM or ENG follow-up issue within 7 days.
- Qualitative: AE/CS satisfaction score >= 4/5 in follow-up survey after 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: Published playbook doc in Confluence with step-by-step triage flow and templates
Intake form template (Slack + email + web) with required fields that map to scorecard
Scorecard documented with weights and example scoring for at least 10 historical cases
Dashboard mock in Figma + one-click CSV export for PMs
Communication templates for commitment windows and escalation closure
